description: The inventory of property managed partly or wholly by the New York City Department of Parks and Recreation, published on NYC Open Data. Each of the 2,061 records is an acquisition, with a name, address, borough, acreage, jurisdiction, class, type category and subcategory, waterfront flag, permit fields, community board, council district, precinct and the boundary as a multipolygon. Type categories include neighbourhood and community parks, playgrounds, gardens, nature areas, triangles and plazas, recreational fields and courts, and cemeteries. Coverage: the five boroughs. Format and access: free download or Socrata API; the page lists monthly automated updates, the data were last updated in September 2026, and no licence is stated. Caveats: the page warns that accuracy is limited by the scale of the secondary source data and that sites should be field-verified. Useful for public space exposure, heat and flood adaptation planning and access analysis; related records are not yet linked.
